detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #13 Tor Bootstrap Readiness A listening socket does not prove Tor has finished bootstrapping. PH4NTXM's Lone Wolf readiness check authenticates to Tor's local control socket using the service's cookie. It validates ownership and requires the bootstrap response to report progress 100 with the done tag. Incomplete bootstrap, unexpected replies, or invalid permissions produce a failed result. That result feeds the DNS supervisor and browser-launch requirements, so the session evaluates Tor's actual reported startup state before presenting the browser path as ready. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
